items.html: And when we evaluate the lower man in this totality, it comes out that since the NHY of Arich rose into the HGT of AVI, in their chest and not in his own HGT, as above — and it is found that the Ibur of ZA was there, in the HGT, in the AVI of the totality of the Partzuf that includes the four Partzufim, as is known — it is in their exact half.
